jobs.title: Senior DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Senior DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer at Thndr, you'll be part of our fast-growing fintech team. We are looking for someone who can bring deep expertise and hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, containerization, networking, and DevOps best practices. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, capable of designing, implementing, and guiding a robust DevOps and infrastructure roadmap across both cloud and on-premise environments. You will play a critical role in building scalable, resilient, and secure systems that support our mission-critical financial applications.

 

What You'll Do

  • Architect, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure across AWS and on-premise environments.

  • Lead containerization and orchestration strategy using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring deployment, scaling, and security best practices.

  • Design and manage complex networking solutions, including VPCs, subnets, routing, firewalls, VPNs, load balancers, PrivateLinks, Direct Connect, and AWS Secure VPN setup

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer / DevSecOps
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About The Role

This Senior Cyber Security Engineer / DevSecOps role is a highly collaborative position designed for a security professional who can seamlessly bridge the gap between offensive exploitation and defensive engineering. Instead of sitting in a silo, you will be deeply embedded within the product, engineering, and infrastructure teams to champion security architecture from the ground up.

 

What You'll Do

• Work closely with the product and engineering teams to review new features and suggest new features that improve security.

• Drive S-SDLC in our cycles and review security acceptance criteria and threat modeling.

• Guide and train the team to cover security checks and security best practices.

• Perform pre-deployment and post-deployment security penetration tests.

• Plan and execute regular web, mobile, and cloud security assessments and pen tests.

• Work closely with the Infrastructure teams to identify security issues through red teaming activities.

• Define, implement, and monitor infrastructure security measures.

• Contribute to the security roadmap & backlog.
